newsitem.title: USA: TCI Satellite agrees to sell satellite.
newsitem.headline: TCI Satellite agrees to sell satellite.

text.p: TCI Satellite Inc, recently spun off by Tele-Communications Inc, said on Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to sell one of its Tempo satellites to Telesat Canada.
It said a definitive agreement is expected to be signed early next year.
The satellite is being sold at cost, payable over time.

The purchase is subject to several conditions, including the successful launch of an addtional Tempo satellite into Tempo's orbital slot at 119 degrees west longitude, plus appropriate Canadian government approvals.
Under the agreement, Tempo has the option to use services provided by Telesat in the future.
